walls.note: The Amstel front (facade ring edge 0, 9.4 m), read on the frontal 2022 crop TMX7316010203-002543_pano_0000_000105 (w01-16.alt.jpg, 50.2 px/m, sharper than the dusk 2024 crop) and the 2024 aimed view. This is pand 0363100012179461: BAG lists Amstel 2 and Muntplein 1 in it, the door bay at the front's east end carries the number 2, and the corner turret at its west end is the one the w02 aimed view shows on its left. The second turret in the w02 aimed view (over the maoz shop) belongs to Reguliersbreestraat 1 (BAG 0363100012179460, 1890), a separate pand.
